newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber up to new highs on hurricane concerns.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber up to new highs on hurricane concerns.

text.p: CME lumber futures ran up for a near limit advance and set new contract highs as concern over Hurricane Edouard reinforced a recent strong tone in firm cash lumber markets, traders said.

September posted a new high of $410.50 per thousand board feet and highest price level in 2-1/2 years. November set a new high of $370.00 per tbf before futures met resitance. Prices are currently $9.30 to $1.50 higher with September up most at $410.20 and November up $7.50 at $370.00 per tbf.
Edouard, a Category 3 hurricane, could possibly hit Florida or the eastern seaboard within five or six days.
